Job Description:

Southwest Airlines promises to provide Employees with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. The Solutions Architect supports the Architecture Emerging Trends and Innovation Team within Southwest to define solutions that align to enterprise strategies and standards. They’ll define the AI architecture by adding tools and processes, participate in the design and implementation of enterprise artificial intelligence solutions, and provide guidance and support for all aspects of arterial intelligence including and not limited to traditional AI/ML, generative AI and embedded AI. The Solutions Architect is a strong communicator and problem solver who is ready to drive the future of Southwest’s Technology.

• This role is offered as a remote workplace position, which may require travel for trainings, meetings, conferences, etc. Outside of those required visits, the majority of your working time may be spent in a remote location, away from our Corporate Campus. Please note, while this is a remote position, there is limited group of states or localities ineligible for Employees to regularly perform their work off-site. Those ineligible locations are: Alaska, Delaware, New Jersey, North Dakota, South Dakota, Vermont, West Virginia, and Wyoming.  
• U.S. citizenship or current authorization to work in the U.S. required and no current or future work authorization sponsorship available.

Southwest Airlines is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We continue to look for opportunities to reflect the communities we serve, and welcome applicants with diverse thoughts, backgrounds, and experiences.

Job Summary of Lead AI Product Developer:

Working remotely is an option for the Lead AI Product Developer, making it easier for professionals to work from wherever they are most comfortable

By utilizing human-led AI systems, Capital One aims to disrupt and rebuild the banking industry. Capital One, through its utilization of machine learning creates real-time, intelligent, and automated customer experiences. Capital One's AI-ML applications make banking simpler, providing a human touch while keeping customers informed about unusual charges and answering their questions in real time. With the investments made in their machine learning platforms and public cloud infrastructure, Capital One is well-positioned to leverage AI technology. The company's world-class applied science and engineering teams continue to lead in the industry, offering breakthrough products and scalable, high-performance AI infrastructure. Joining Capital One provides a chance to reimagine banking and bring emerging AI capabilities to customers and businesses alike.

Our organization is in search of a skilled Lead AI Product Developer with extensive experience developing and maintaining APIs and SDKs that enable scalable AI models; this will become a significant part of our Enterprise AI team. You will be instrumental in creating systems that allow customers to access LLMs and FMs through our public cloud environment. Collaborating with a world-class group of AI engineers and researchers, you will help develop application programming interfaces for critical product and services to meet our customers' core needs.

• Plan, develop, and deploy well-managed core APIs and SDKs for accessing LLMs and our exclusive FMs, such as training, refining, and prompting tasks, incorporating orchestration SDKs.
• Ensure that APIs are easy to use and intuitive for developers to implement, reducing the time and effort required to integrate them into their applications.
• Use LLMs and FMs to design tailored interfaces that elevate the user experience for both associates and customers.
• Provide our users with the means to build fresh GenAI features.
• An essential aspect of safeguarding the integrity of API access patterns and operational health is developing tools and processes that can accurately detect and address irregularities.
• Design and deploy safety mechanisms, such as fail-safes and monitoring protocols, that actively monitor and manage AI behavior and performance.

• Obtaining a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a comparable technical field by attending a four-year degree program

• To be eligible for this position, the applicant must possess at least 6 years of experience with programming languages like Java, Go, Python, or Scala
• A requirement for this position is to have at least 12 months of experience managing, improving, and scaling deep neural network training or inferencing processes

• Proficiency in developing and operating AI initiatives meant for accommodating millions of users across NLP, speech, computer vision, and recommendation systems.
• Demonstrating proficiency in managing conflicting demands and challenging timeframes.

About Us

At Union, we are solving one of the hardest challenges in AI infrastructure today: enabling high-velocity iteration while maintaining seamless production-readiness for AI workloads at scale. Flyte, the open-source project we steward, is the emerging standard for modern data and AI orchestration, with numerous leading technology organizations - like LinkedIn, Spotify, and Gojek - running millions of mission-critical workloads on the platform. We have a deep bench of infrastructure veterans from companies in the Big Three and beyond and a technical founding team who originally created Flyte while at Lyft.

Reporting to our Head of Platform Engineering, you will play a critical role in building the platform that allows Union’s engineering teams to deliver cutting edge product capabilities to our growing customer base. We are looking for innately curious individuals, who pride themselves on their ability to look around corners, build with simplicity and resiliency and are relentlessly focused on the customer.

In this role, you will:
• Design and build a platform that allows Union to support its products on any computing platform, including cloud providers such as AWS, GCP, and Azure, as well as large enterprise data centers
• Design and build continuous integration, verification and deployment strategies for distributed software applications
• Help the team expand the the Union Cloud product to multiple public and private cloud providers
• Develop and maintain tooling to make our systems more reliable, secure and performant
• Design and build scalable monitoring and observability systems and best practices
• Work closely with broader Engineering teams to improve developer experience

About you:
• Strong technical background with 5+ years experience as an Infrastructure, Platform or SRE Engineer
• You are a curious engineer with a desire to work at a fast paced startup, we often wear multiple hats
• You have experience leading complex projects from planning to completion
• You like to think about the big picture and how all of the components of the system fit together
• Proficient in writing complex software using Golang and Python
• Bonus points if you have hands-on experience with multi-tenant environments

What to expect:
• We are a customer focused company and aim to provide value to our customers quickly and reliability (in other words, we like to move fast)
• We are a small team and we wear many hats, with lots of opportunities to learn new things

• Languages: Golang, Python and Typescript
• Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
• CI/CD: Buildkite, ArgoCD
• Cloud Providers: AWS, GCP, Azure

• Flexible work schedule at a remote friendly company

We believe that our differences are what bring us together to achieve truly special outcomes. We strive to be inclusive and focus on building teams that embody that quality too. Union.ai is an equal-opportunity employer and we encourage you to apply, even if your experience doesn’t align exactly with our job description.

Zest AI has been perfecting AI for consumer lending decisions since 2009. Our mission is to broaden access to equitable lending and our AI-enabled software creates some of the most inclusive risk models in the industry. Our Model Management System helps lenders make better decisions and better loans — increasing revenue, reducing risk, and automating compliance — while expanding credit access to deserving people with no added risk!
